verses.1: And Jehovah said to me, “Take for yourself a large tablet and write on it by human hand the time when the harvest will be gathered.”
verses.2: And I will have true witnesses testify for me against Uria the priest and Zaccharias son of Jebereх.
verses.3: And I went to the prophet. She became pregnant and gave birth to a son. Then God said to me, “Call his name Shalal Chash.”
verses.4: For before the boy could say, “My father and mother, please bring out my sword and my armor before the king of Assyria,”
verses.5: And Jehovah continued to speak to me again.
verses.6: For this people have rejected the message that those who go there are trying to spread. They also reject Rezin and Ben-Ramliahu.
verses.7: And so, behold, Adonai raised up the waters of the river over them. He also raised up King Ashur and all his glory. He also raised up all his troops and went upon all their chariots.
verses.8: And in Judah, he swept over everything, reaching even to the borders of Yagiyah. His wings were filled with dust from your land; let them accompany us along with us.
verses.9: They listened, and they obeyed. They gathered from all corners of the earth. They listened, and they obeyed.
verses.10: They made a decision, and they spoke their words. But nothing happened, because there was no one with us.
verses.11: For as Jehovah said to me, “With the strength of my hand, I will remove you from being king over this people.”
verses.12: Do not say that everything said by this people is true. They are false, and their words should not be believed or accepted.
verses.13: May Jehovah, your God, sanctify him; he will rule over you and bless you.
verses.14: And it shall become a holy place, and a place of worship for the two tribes of Israel. It will also be a place where people can rest and take refuge.
verses.15: And many of them were defeated, and they fell, and were captured and taken away.
verses.16: The seal was placed on the scroll of Torah in Limudai.
verses.17: And I waited for Yahweh, who hides his face from the house of Jacob. I longed for him.
verses.18: Behold, I and the children whom Jehovah has given to me for priests and for offerings in Israel, are with Jehovah’s army, who are encamped on Mount Zion.
verses.19: And if they say to you, “They ask their fathers and the wise men who can give them knowledge. So why don’t people ask their gods for help?”
verses.20: For revelation and for guidance, if they do not say this very thing that has no basis in reality.
verses.21: And there was suffering, hunger, and misery. It was like a time of famine. People became angry and resentful towards their kings and gods. They turned their backs on them.
verses.22: And he looked at the land, and behold, it was desolate and ruined. It was a place of destruction and despair.
verses.23: For it is not desirable that the land be weakened just now, when it has already been weakened before. The land of Zebulun and the land of Naftali will also be weakened. And the other land will be burdened along the sea route, across the Jordan River, along the road to Gilead.
